text_block_list.text:
And then, the day of the Hanshin Daishoten 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's all ready! Engine's fully charged, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi, Maya's a good girl who keeps her 
promises~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Brian-san, that's mean!! How could 
you say that to Maya~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...You're the one who treated yourself 
like a brat, aren't ya? Tsk..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Come at me with everything you've got 
today!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare go easy on me. Maya wants 
to beat Brian-san when she's like this.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because I think that way will make me 
shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! That's so meaaan! Maya is totally 
serious, you knowーー!
